definitions.gloss: happy family gathering, quality time together, convivial circle
definitions.explanation: A warm, pleasant gathering of family members or close people, typically involving conversation, meals, or shared activities in a relaxed atmosphere. Emphasizes the warmth and harmony of being together.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧{団|だん}らん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧にして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I value our family quality time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食卓|しょくたく}→食卓：03246_shokutaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{囲|かこ}んで→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧{団|だん}らん⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Gather around the dinner table and enjoy time together.

examples.japanese: ⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{夕食|ゆうしょく}→夕食：03006_yuushoku⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧{団|だん}らん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{決|き}めている→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: Even in our busy daily lives, we've decided to make dinnertime our family togetherness time.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always used in the context of family. The full kanji form is {団欒|だんらん}, but the mixed form {団|だん}らん is more common in modern writing. Strongly associated with meals shared around a table and carries a warm, nostalgic tone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧{団|だん}らん: family quality time
- {団|だん}らん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: time spent together
- {団|だん}らん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ひととき→ひととき：10494_hitotoki⟧: a moment of togetherness
- ⟦{食卓|しょくたく}→食卓：03246_shokutaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{囲|かこ}んで→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧{団|だん}らん: gather around the table for family time
- {団|だん}らん⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧: enjoy time together
